'''Nelant''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where he built and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as armor upgrades and materials, in a small shop.
